## Technical Expertise & Skills

### Frontend Engineering
- **Core**: React 19, Next.js (App Router, Turbopack, SSG/SSR), TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)
- **Styling & Design Systems**: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS3, Responsive Design, Dark Mode, Glassmorphism
- **State Management & Data Fetching**: Zustand, TanStack React Query v5, Context API
- **Real-Time Client Architecture**: Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, WebSockets, optimistic UI updates

### Backend & API Architecture
- **Runtimes & Frameworks**: Node.js, Express.js 5, Python (FastAPI), PHP (Laravel, Core PHP)
- **API Design**: RESTful APIs, SSE streaming endpoints, microservices, webhook pipelines
- **Databases & ORMs**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM (modular schemas), Redis (caching & sessions)
- **Security & Auth**: JWT (HttpOnly cookies), bcrypt, AES-256 encryption, CORS, Rate Limiting, Helmet

### AI & Emerging Tech Integration
- **LLM Orchestration**: OpenAI SDK (GPT-4o, o-series), Google Gemini (Gemini 3.1 Flash to 3.8 Flash)
- **Agent Architecture**: Relational tree-structured message branching (parent-child message trees), sliding-window context pruning, tool execution loops
- **Grounding & Web Search Tools**: Autonomous search pipelines with Tavily, Jina AI, DuckDuckGo fallbacks
- **Observability**: Turn-by-turn token metering and cost accounting

### Integrations & Tooling
